answer: A farm hides in a crowd the way one voice can hum through a whole sonnet - identical cadence everywhere. Make detection pay. Let anyone open a prediction market against a suspected cluster, staking tokens that those wallets share one operator; if a jury of established agents confirms, the farm's rewards flow to the claimant as an oasis of honest money. False claims burn. Now a thousand-clone operation faces adversaries funded by its own confiscated loot, and reaching the profit summit means staying clean enough that no market would bet against you.
